summary: A trebuchet or cannon. The server owns its cycle, idle, drawing, loading, ready or firing, its operator, ammunition, health and the result of each shot, and players' games draw it. At speed 1, a trebuchet reaches 25 to 250 m and reloads in 110 s, and a cannon reaches 10 to 200 m and reloads in 12 s. Loading, aiming and firing return { accepted, reason, seconds }. Events are siegeEngineSpawn, siegeEngineUse, which can refuse, siegeEngineReady, siegeFire, siegeImpact, siegeEngineDamage, siegeEngineWreck and siegeEngineDestroy.

params.orientation: Optional: Euler degrees or a Quaternion. None by default.
params.dimension: Optional: by default, the shared one.

spawn.exampleLua:
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

local trebuchet = kcds.world.SiegeEngine.spawn("trebuchet", Vector3.new(100, 200, 10))
trebuchet.usable = true
trebuchet.damage = 400
trebuchet.maxHealth = 1000
trebuchet.ammo = 10

kcds.core.Events.on("siegeEngineReady", function(engine)
  engine:fire(Vector3.new(250, 300, 12))
end)
trebuchet:load()

all.summary: All engines, or those in one dimension.

params.dimension: Optional: limits it to this dimension.

all.exampleLua:
for _, engine in ipairs(kcds.world.SiegeEngine.all()) do
  print(engine.kind .. ": " .. engine.cycle)
end

getById.summary: The engine with this network id, or null.

destroyAll.summary: Removes all engines, or those in one dimension.

params.dimension: Optional: limits it to this dimension.

loaded.summary: Whether it is ready to fire.
loaded.exampleLua:
if trebuchet.loaded then
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToAll("The trebuchet is loaded!")
end

speed.summary: How fast the crew works, 0.1 to 20, default 1. You can assign to it, and a step in progress is rescaled.

damage.summary: Damage at the centre of an impact, default 0, none. You can assign to it.

blastRadius.summary: How far damage reaches from an impact, up to 100 m, default 10. You can assign to it.

usable.summary: Whether players can operate it, default false. You can assign to it.

range.summary: The range the guide shows, limited to minRange and maxRange. You can assign to it.

minRange.summary: The shortest distance it can hit.

maxRange.summary: The longest distance it can hit.

reloadTime.summary: Seconds for a full reload at the current speed.

maxHealth.summary: Its maximum health. 0, the default, means it cannot be damaged. Assigning heals it fully.

health.summary: Its health. You can assign to it, up to maxHealth.

wrecked.summary: Whether health has reached 0. A wrecked engine cannot load or fire until repaired.

ammo.summary: Shots left, and each load uses one. A negative number, -1 by default, never runs out. You can assign to it.

crewMinimum.summary: How many crew places must be filled. You can assign to it, up to crewSeats.

crewSeats.summary: Its crew places: 2 winches on a trebuchet, none on a cannon.

operator.summary: The player operating it, or null.
operator.exampleLua:
if trebuchet.operator then
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(trebuchet.operator, "Fire at will.")
end

crew.summary: Its crew places, each a player or null.

load.summary: Starts a reload, using one ammo. It is refused while wrecked, busy, already loaded or out of ammo.
load.exampleLua:
local answer = trebuchet:load()
if not answer.accepted then
  print("no reload: " .. tostring(answer.reason))
end

fire.summary: Turns to the target and fires a loaded engine. Everything within blastRadius of the impact takes a share of the damage.

params.attacker: Optional: the player credited with the shot.

aim.summary: Turns the engine to a target in range.
aim.exampleLua:
local accepted, seconds = trebuchet:aim(kcds.math.Vector3.new(250, 300, 12)).accepted, trebuchet:aim(kcds.math.Vector3.new(250, 300, 12)).seconds
if accepted then
  print("turning for " .. tostring(seconds) .. " s")
end

inReach.summary: Why it cannot hit a point, or '' if it can.
inReach.exampleLua:
local problem = trebuchet:inReach(target)
if problem ~= "" then
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "Out of reach: " .. tostring(problem))
end

showAimLine.summary: Shows or hides the aim guide to players.

repair.summary: Restores full health and ends the wrecked state.

assignGunner.summary: Puts a player in the operator's place, removing them from any other engine, or empties it with null.
